data.name: Pankaj Soun
data.player_statement:
A complete player, Pankaj Soun has made a big mark in cricket. With 8 turns at the crease, they've hit a top score of 19*, with an average of 10.60 and a quick strike rate of 115.22. Their knack for hitting big shots is evident with 2 sixes and 5 fours.

Equally good at bowling, they've bowled 18.0 overs, taking 5 wickets at an economy rate of 9.33. Despite a few wides, their accuracy is top-notch, making them a key player for their team.
